title: Avalon Technologies Ltd - 543896 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

summary.headline: Avalon Technologies Q2 FY27 revenue rose 37.4% YoY to Rs 525 crore, PAT up 59.5% to Rs 40 crore, and FY27 growth guidance raised to around 30%.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 was the ninth consecutive quarter of growth, with revenue of Rs 525 crore (up 37.4% YoY, up 8.5% QoQ), EBITDA of Rs 66 crore (up 71% YoY) and PAT of Rs 40 crore at a 7.5% margin. H1 revenue reached Rs 1,010 crore (up 43%) with EBITDA up 81% and PAT up 91%. Management announced a 25-acre Orgadam (SIPCOT, Tamil Nadu) campus MoU and a 51:49 JV with Zolner Electronic AG, backed by a proposed warrant issue of up to Rs 425 crore to Zolner. Working capital days improved to 120 and ROCE rose to 24.2%, while H1 capex of Rs 90 crore included about Rs 35 crore of land.

financial_highlights.change: +71% YoY; margin from 10.1% a year ago and 12.0% in Q1
from 131 a year ago; 128 at Q1 end
including about Rs 35 crore land purchase

financial_highlights.value: Q2 negative Rs 22 crore; H1 positive Rs 10 crore

segments.name: Industrial
segments.commentary: 35% of Q2 revenue, growing 36% YoY. Semiconductor equipment revenue is currently reported within industrial and will be broken out once it reaches about 10% of revenue.

segments.name: Energy
segments.commentary: 29% of Q2 revenue, more than doubling YoY.

segments.name: Mobility
segments.commentary: 25% of Q2 revenue, growing 27% YoY. Rail was 17% of revenue; aerospace was 8% and grew over 40%.

segments.name: Geography
segments.commentary: India contributed 29% of Q2 revenue (up 37% YoY) and exports 61% (up 38% YoY). By manufacturing location, India was 74% of Q2 revenue at 17.1% EBITDA margin and 11.4% PAT margin; US losses narrowed to Rs 4.8 crore.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to around 30%, from 26-30% earlier.
Management aims to double revenue again from FY26 to FY29, after nearly achieving the FY24-27 doubling goal a year early.
Working capital guided within 120-130 days; Q2 was at 120 days.
Capex to remain elevated for one to two more years due to the Orgadam land and campus; asset turns guided in high single digits or higher.
EBITDA margin improvement targeted over a three-year horizon.
Zolner JV: Avalon has an option to raise its stake to 51% three years after commercial production starts; warrant proceeds for capex, debt repayment and general corporate purposes.
capex_capacity: 25-acre Orgadam campus in SIPCOT (Tamil Nadu) under MoU; detailed plan and timelines are still being finalised, to be shared in coming quarters.
H1 FY27 capex Rs 90 crore, of which about Rs 35 crore was land; capex was about Rs 25-50 crore a year in recent years.

Zolner JV (Zolner Avalon Pvt Ltd): 51% Zolner, 49% Avalon; PCB assembly, box build and integrated systems in India. Avalon supplies metals, plastics, cables and magnetics. Until the JV facility is ready, production for new customers will be outsourced to Avalon.
Rs 11 crore investment in Revo's Autotech for EV charging hardware.
demand_pricing: Q2 order intake was about Rs 678 crore. Order book is Rs 2,367 crore (average execution 14 months), plus long-term contracts of Rs 1,275 crore executable over 15-36 months.
Semiconductor equipment: working with four to five global customers; revenue is currently in industrial. Management expects it to reach about 10% of revenue in coming quarters.
Zolner's European customers (rail, industrial, test and measurement, medical and life sciences) are making India visits. Test and measurement and medical/life sciences are new verticals for Avalon.
Top 10 customers are about 64% of revenue. Customer ticket sizes have grown from USD 5-10 million five years ago to USD 20-40 million now.
Management said there is no evidence of customers stockpiling inventory and no lumpiness in sales; the last nine quarters averaged 45% revenue growth.

qa_highlights.question: How big can semiconductor and Zolner JV revenue become, and when?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to give a number. Semiconductor should be a separate segment within about 12 months once it reaches roughly 10% of revenue. Zolner customer visits have started, but onboarding takes time because of customer approval processes.

qa_highlights.question: Why did EBITDA margin rise to 12.6%, and is it sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Operating leverage: employee cost fell to 16.1% of sales from 18.3% a year ago. Management said it aims to improve margins further over three years.

qa_highlights.question: Will the US facility reach sustained EBITDA breakeven, and will it expand?
qa_highlights.answer: The US is a strategic cost centre for customer qualification and hybrid final assembly. Management has no plans for more overseas factories and aims to move work to India, subject to geopolitics.

qa_highlights.question: What is driving the high H1 capex and what is the outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: About Rs 35 crore of H1 capex was land. Capex will be higher for one to two years, after which asset turns should be in the high single digits or higher.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Zolner JV's option structure?
qa_highlights.answer: Zolner holds 51% and Avalon 49% initially. Avalon can raise its stake to 51% after three years of commercial production, subject to conditions.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a clean energy opportunity in India?
qa_highlights.answer: Management is cautious: it sees the segment as likely to commoditise in India, so it will pursue only profitable growth there.

risks_watch: Timing of programmes moving from prototype to production depends on external factors, so quarterly revenue can be lumpy; management said planning will be conservative.
Geopolitics and tariffs could change the US versus India production mix; management said the US is flexible and India margins are higher.
Working capital is elevated (Rs 120 crore net debt; inventory built for upcoming programmes); operating cash flow was negative Rs 22 crore in Q2.
Warrant issue to Zolner (up to Rs 425 crore) needs AGM approval; 25% is payable upfront and the balance within 18 months.
Semiconductor revenue timing: first orders expected in Q4 FY27 and next year, with the 10% threshold depending on customer conversion.
Top 10 customers are 64% of revenue, which is a concentration risk.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth, margins and balance sheet, but guarded on timing: management kept FY27 guidance at around 30% and repeatedly cautioned that program kick-ins are uncertain. It was evasive on quantifying semiconductor and Zolner JV revenue.
key_quotes: Q2 FY27 marks our ninth consecutive quarter of growth.
Our gross margins have stayed stable over the last six years despite terrorist global conflicts, rising freight and raw material costs.
The day we start doing products of our own, it doesn't bear value with most of our larger customers.
So it is dangerous for the customer base.

adds.what: 25-acre Orgadam (SIPCOT, Tamil Nadu) campus under MoU; detailed plan and timelines still being finalised
Zolner Avalon Pvt Ltd PCB assembly/box build JV facility in India (51% Zolner, 49% Avalon); new-customer production outsourced to Avalon until ready

growth.why: FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to around 30% (from 26-30%), backed by a Rs 2,367 crore order book (+27% YoY) plus Rs 1,275 crore long-term contracts and Q2 order intake of about Rs 678 crore; capacity additions (Orgadam campus, Zolner JV) are still at MoU/planning stage with no timelines, so backing is partial.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: EBITDA margin rose to 12.6% in Q2 from 10.1% a year ago (12.0% in Q1) on operating leverage, with employee cost down to 16.1% of sales from 18.3%, and management targets further improvement over three years.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Orgadam 25-acre SIPCOT campus is only at MoU stage with timelines still being finalised, and the Zolner JV facility has no date; new-customer production is outsourced to Avalon until the JV is ready, so no new capacity is firmly dated in the window.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: FY27 revenue growth guided to around 30% (raised from 26-30%), backed by a Rs 2,367 crore order book (+27% YoY), Rs 1,275 crore long-term contracts and Q2 order intake of about Rs 678 crore, though program timing is flagged as lumpy.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: H1 FY27 capex was Rs 90 crore (about Rs 35 crore land), management says capex stays elevated for one to two more years, and the Orgadam campus plan and timelines are to be shared in coming quarters.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 guidance was just raised to around 30% and H1 revenue is up 43%, but management kept guidance cautious and stressed that program kick-ins are uncertain.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Order book of Rs 2,367 crore and H1 revenue of Rs 1,010 crore (+43%) support the raised 30% guide, though lumpy programme timing is a watch item.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Semiconductor equipment first orders are expected in Q4 FY27 and next year, with management aiming for about 10% of revenue (separate segment within about 12 months), but no quantified revenue was given.

rows.label: Zolner JV and new verticals (test & measurement, medical)
rows.why: Zolner customer visits have started and test and measurement and medical/life sciences are new verticals, but onboarding takes time due to customer approval processes and management declined to size it.

rows.label: Zolner warrant issue up to Rs 425 crore
rows.why: Warrant issue needs AGM approval; 25% payable upfront and balance within 18 months, with proceeds for capex, debt repayment and general corporate purposes against net debt of Rs 120 crore.

rows.label: Working capital held within 120-130 days
rows.why: Working capital days improved to 120 from 131 a year ago, and management guides 120-130 days, though inventory is being built for upcoming programmes and Q2 operating cash flow was negative Rs 22 crore.

tone.note: Management was confident on growth, margins and balance sheet (ROCE 24.2%, 30% FY27 guide, revenue doubling FY26-FY29) but cautious on programme timing and evasive on sizing semiconductor and Zolner JV revenue; analysts pressed on those two areas and on margin sustainability.
